description: This file implements a Windows UWP-specific audio device interface using WASAPI, managing default audio render device changes, format support, and device activation.

classes.name: DefaultAudioRenderParams
classes.description: Manages cached parameters for the default audio render device, including support for passthrough codecs and reacting to device change events.

classes.name: WASAPIAudioDevice
classes.description: Represents a WASAPI-based audio device, handling initialization, format support, and device activation.

methods.name: SetPassthroughWaveformat
methods.description: Configures a WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE structure for passthrough audio codecs (AC3 or EAC3).

methods.name: DefaultAudioRenderParams
methods.description: Constructor that registers a device change event handler.

methods.name: ~DefaultAudioRenderParams
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the device change event handler.

methods.name: GetBitrate
methods.description: Returns cached bitrate of the default audio renderer.

methods.name: GetNumChannels
methods.description: Returns cached number of channels of the default audio renderer.

methods.name: GetPassthroughCodecSupport
methods.description: Checks support for a specific passthrough audio codec.

methods.name: OnDefaultAudioRenderDeviceChanged
methods.description: Event handler that marks cache as dirty and clears MIME support cache.

methods.name: RefreshCachedParamsIfNeeded_Locked
methods.description: Refreshes cached device parameters if marked dirty.

methods.name: WASAPIAudioDevice
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the audio device.

methods.name: ~WASAPIAudioDevice
methods.description: Destructor that closes the activation handle.

methods.name: InitializeAudioDevice
methods.description: Starts asynchronous activation of the default audio device.

methods.name: ActivateCompleted
methods.description: Callback for completing device activation, setting up the audio client and format support.
